description:
About this space
This modern, creative space is one of two hidden gems in the leafy suburb of Westville (also see Yellow Room at The Hidden Lookout)
Up high in the trees, our space is a tranquil, beautiful, simple space, perfect for a break from the city, but close enough to everything to still have fun!
If you are coming for business we have a fast and dependable WiFi & work station & GENERATOR if necessary.

The space
It’s like our own little complex. Original house on the front with another Bnb attached (The Sunny Corner)
“The Hidden Lookout” at the back. “The Yellow Room” on the right, “The Green Room” on the left. We stay in the middle.

Your Condo has: Sml fridge, microwave, kettle, toaster, cutlery, crockery, towels, toilet paper, coffee, tea, sugar, sml milk bottle of water & 2 rusks

Guest access
Your private room is yours to enjoy with a slice of balcony to watch the eagles soar.

Other things to note
The Querks of “New” living:

Curtains! Who needs those! Wake up with the sun, watch the stars & city lights twinkle. The closest people are 2km away, so to them you look like an Ant 🐜

Oh my Gosh! No TV!
Yes! Connect with your partner & nature, make this time count! We do have fast WIFI tho.

The people who share a wall have children, so you may hear them if you are lucky 😉 Let it be a reminder to condomise 😉

The toilet & shower are “Open Plan” 😳 …. be open with your partner, or go for a walk.

I must wash dishes & brush teeth in the same basin!!! Just wash the dishes and wipe the counter after dinner, it’s a great habit to form 😉
